items.title: Commit a formatter config matching the chess repo's style
items.brief: ntucker/chess has no Prettier config, so agents' global Prettier defaults (double quotes, 80 columns) reformat files on touch (happened in PR #31 commit 9b4850e, reverted in a81adcc). Add a committed Prettier config matching the existing style (single quotes, long lines, check what width the source uses, likely 100-120), plus a lint or CI check, without reformatting the whole repo in an unrelated PR. Suggested by the Staff reviewer on PR #31.
